integrity: All positive parameters and equilibrium equations were checked in exact rational arithmetic. The full five-dimensional characteristic polynomial and Routh signs are independently reproducible using the included standalone script. The preprint posted 2026-04-15 is the earliest verified public version.
scientific_limitations: Exact local counterexample for the original five-state equations with the source's specified simulation feedback laws. Not a proof of Hopf bifurcation, nonlinear oscillations, global dynamics, or empirical parameter applicability.
title: Endogenous rate feedback destabilizes a Hurwitz SIR-ID endemic equilibrium
